title: Two bishops
line: Side by side, they drive the king into a corner.

steps.text: Two bishops side by side make a wall of diagonals the king cannot cross. Your king walks up, and the black king is pushed back.
The black king runs toward the far corner. A bishop check sends it there faster, and your king follows it.
Your king steps in, and the light-square bishop takes the last squares on the back rank. The king is nearly boxed in.
Step your king right in front of the black king. It still has the corner, so this is not stalemate.
steps.hint: Your king moves down the board, toward the black king.
steps.after: The black king goes into the corner.

steps.text: Bring the dark-square bishop onto the long diagonal, ready to check next. Leave Black a move.

also.a5d2: That works too: the bishop can check from there next. This lesson goes on with the long diagonal.
also.a5e1: That works too: the bishop can check from there next. This lesson goes on with the long diagonal.
also.a5b4: That works too: the bishop can check from there next. This lesson goes on with the long diagonal.

steps.hint: The bishop on a5 slides back along its diagonal, toward your side of the board.
steps.after: Black has one move: out of the corner.

steps.text: Check with the dark-square bishop. The king must go back into the corner.
steps.hint: The bishop checks along the diagonal that ends on b8.
steps.after: The king is back in the corner.

steps.text: Now mate with the other bishop. Careful: here every move that is not check is stalemate.

wrong.e5c7: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.e5d6: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.f5d7: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.b6a6: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.

steps.hint: Check along the long diagonal that ends in the corner.
steps.after: Checkmate. One bishop checks, the other guards b8, and your king takes the rest.

summary: Keep the bishops side by side, bring your king, and drive the king into a corner. Leave it a move until the mate.
